Reference lock / overload / freshness / drift / leakage
Recoverable QC issue → recalibrate; hard fault → pause
Fit amplitude / phase / drive dependence; compare controls
Propose a repeat, a new setting or a discriminating test
Limits + locks + versioned update / recorded closure
Objective met / budget reached → archive + close
Theory MCP / numerical jobs / versioned models
X/Y, I, f, T/B/Vg + calibration + snapshot IDs
Residuals, validity range and competing explanations
Lower drive; add frequency / return controls

Every revision preserves raw evidence and passes
No LLM in the timing-critical path
Event-driven QC and bounded stage revisions
Dashboard follows state and qualified data
A local LLM is not a numerical physics solver
Transport workflow design; the theory/compute coupling is planned. No measured curves or material mechanism claims are implied.
